title: Bluinzi 46 Inch Compact Umbrellas for Rain - Travel Small Umbrella - Automatic Folding Umbrella - Windproof Portable Umbrella, Double 10-rib

reviews.title: Umbrella
reviews.body: This umbrella really impressed me with its quality. It’s compact and easy to carry, perfect for keeping in your bag or car. The automatic system works great—it opens and closes with just the push of a button, which is super convenient when your hands are full.The material feels durable and holds up well against wind without flipping easily. The design is sleek, and it comes nicely packaged in a box, making it a great option for a gift.Definitely a great value for the price. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Under my umbrella, -ella -ella
reviews.body: The Bluinzi umbrella is a good size when opened and provides ample coverage for one person. When closed, it is a compact size but not what I would call mini. It will take some real estate in your purse, briefcase, or bag. It wasn't an issue for me, but that is a consideration for some.The umbrella has two buttons, one to open the canopy and the other to close the canopy. It's probably a good idea to use the buttons to avoid damaging the umbrella by trying to use force to manually operate the umbrella (especially when closing it as a close button isn't as common on umbrellas). Just note that the canopy opens and closes with surprising force. Hopefully, over time and with use that operation becomes smoother.The umbrella is said to be able to withstand winds of 45mph (roughly 72 kph). This does not mean the canopy won't get reversed in strong winds; it just means that it can recover with less risk of damage to the frame and canopy. I've not tested this claim and honestly, I don't know that I would ever be out in a storm with that much wind trying to use an umbrella.The build quality of this umbrella seems to be good. I think where the canopy attaches to the end of the spokes could be better reinforced, but it isn't any different than most umbrellas. Obviously, the automatic open/close mechanism may eventually prove to be the weak point. Again, that's not specific to this umbrella.Overall, the Bluinzi umbrellas are a very good value if you get them on sale. The normal price is still decent, but nothing special at that range. Regardless, you'll have a good umbrella with some nice features.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 25, 2026
